design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. The caller asks for one thing, that the cover on his necklace go with the piece to his daughter, and the figure that goes across cannot be reached until two things the records owe have been put right: a claim entered in the spring and never answered, and the benefit for the coverage year in progress that was never granted on the anniversary. Neither is mentioned by the customer; both are read out of the coverage rules and found in the ledger. All three figures are reconciled from a four-and-a-half-year history and from two other desks' records (the appraisal register and the workshop's levels), and the refusal turns on a date arithmetic the customer cannot supply: the inspection due date, the grace that follows it, and where the loss fell between them.

SCOPE CLAIMED AND HEADROOM (principle C). Task 0 occupied protection_ext_claim_settlement and protection_ext_cancellation_refund, with the tools record_claim_settlement_8eb9093c and confirm_plan_cancellation_48603509. This task claims the three that were left free: protection_ext_claim_refusal (what is recorded against a claim the coverage does not answer for, tool record_claim_refusal_9dff8781), protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement (what is granted afresh for a coverage year, tool reinstate_benefit_allowance_e0b143ff) and protection_ext_transfer_carryover (what benefit goes across on a transfer, tool confirm_coverage_transfer_42b50f64). The two tasks share no policy, no tool and no computed quantity; with these five the difficulty's extended policies are fully covered and nothing is reserved.

THE STEP 0 DRAW, AS PRINTED. scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0001_fine_jewelry_retailer/tasks/protection_claims_desk --tasks 2 prints for this task {"task": 1, "key": "fine_jewelry_retailer/protection_claims_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 5]}. The tree therefore has exactly two prerequisite problems, and the three computations carry six, five and four declared factors: protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement takes the six, protection_ext_claim_refusal the five and protection_ext_transfer_carryover the four.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root problem: protection_ext_transfer_carryover, the problem the customer's request points at. Prerequisite problems: protection_ext_claim_refusal and protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement, both hanging directly off the root (a fan-out). Edge 1, the root waiting on the allowance grant: kind=value_input, gate=granted_in_window, form=state, prerequisite sentence quoted verbatim from the root policy's own rule, 'What carries across to the new owner is fixed only after the allowance entries booked to the plan carry a grant for the coverage year in progress.' Four-point test: the ordering connective is 'only after'; the side it waits on is a record-visible state, an allowance entry standing inside the coverage year in progress; it names no tool, policy id or code token; and its strength, 'only after' and 'a grant for the coverage year in progress', is exactly the edge's condition. Exactly one write in this difficulty books such an entry, reinstate_benefit_allowance_e0b143ff, and the derivation is the sentence plus the records (the last allowance entry is dated 2025-03-14, eighteen whole months back, while the coverage year in progress began on the anniversary six months ago) plus the grant policy's own rule (which says what is granted afresh for a coverage year and books it) leading to one action. Edge 2, the root waiting on the refusal: kind=value_input, gate=claims_share, form=state, prerequisite sentence 'Coverage passes to a new owner only once every claim entered against the plan that the coverage does not answer for carries the ground on which it was refused.' Same four points: 'only once'; a record-visible state, a ground for refusing standing against the claim; no code names; and exactly the edge's scope, claims the coverage does not answer for. Exactly one write in this difficulty records a ground for refusing, record_claim_refusal_9dff8781, and the derivation is the sentence plus the records (the claim entered on 2026-05-06 under CL-321884 carries claim_outcome not_applicable and denial_reason_code not_applicable) plus the refusal policy's own rule. Seed evidence that each edge is false at the opening: for edge 1, no protection_allowance_reinstated entry is posted later than initial_state.protection_ledger.c5fefa26-8454-4f24-8113-23554b969bab (2025-03-14), so no allowance entry stands inside the coverage year that began on 2026-03-14; for edge 2, initial_state.protection_ledger.407b367f-b61b-4693-b2b5-2ebfe01d5f1a.claim_outcome = 'not_applicable' and initial_state.protection_ledger.407b367f-b61b-4693-b2b5-2ebfe01d5f1a.denial_reason_code = 'not_applicable'. Topological order: the refusal and the grant in either order, then the transfer. Order uniqueness: the two prerequisites are parallel, and both orders were actually run. Grant-then-refusal gives the same refusal figure, 10061.00, as refusal-then-grant, because the only binding of the refusal that the grant could touch is the window the routine work and goodwill are counted over, and neither the chain repairs drawn nor the refusals standing change between the six-month and the twelve-month window on this world; the refusal never touches anything the grant reads. Both orders therefore leave the same three writes with the same arguments and the same terminal state. Deletion sensitivity, actually run: skipping the grant leaves the transfer at 0.00 instead of 2245.32; skipping the refusal leaves it at 2806.65 instead of 2245.32. user_scenario mentions no prerequisite: Anselm asks only that the cover go with the necklace, and says nothing about a claim, an allowance or anything outstanding. The tool layer blocks nothing: confirm_coverage_transfer_42b50f64 reads the plan row, writes the request record and the plan's transfer fields and returns a line; it has no branch that inspects a claim outcome or an allowance entry, so with either prerequisite unresolved it would still write the transfer with whatever figure it was given.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Write 1, subject protection_claim_denied. The only governing base policy is protection_claim_intake, whose two eligibility gates both apply to protection_claim_filed and not to a refusal, so the policy governs this write by scope: it fixes which single ground is recorded, and the ground here is the inspection lapse. Write 2, subject protection_allowance_reinstated. Governing policies: protection_allowance_grant, gate grantable_state, 'An allowance grant or reinstatement is booked only while the plan stands at active, inspection overdue or exhausted, and never against a plan that has closed.' Authority system_record, timing pre_action, correlation key protection_plans.protection_plan_id bound to the action argument protection_plan_id; at frozen time the plan stands active, having been put back in good standing by the inspection of 2026-06-08, so the gate holds. protection_agg_allowance_pooling has no structured eligibility and governs by scope: the allowance granted belongs to this plan and this piece alone. Write 3, subject protection_plan_transferred. Governing policy protection_transfer, gate plan_transferable_state, 'A transfer is recorded only while the plan stands at active, and coverage that is suspended or out of good standing is put right before it is transferred.' The plan stands active at frozen time, so the gate holds; the coverage also requires an inspection before a transfer takes effect, and the inspection of 2026-06-08 stands on the record. No time gate governs any of the three writes, so temporal_feasibility is empty. The dates that matter are nevertheless worked all the way through, because the refusal ground rests on them: the inspection of 2025-09-12 set the next one due six whole months later, on 2026-03-12; the coverage's inspection grace of 45 calendar days ran to 2026-04-26 inclusive, so a loss reported on 2026-04-26 would still have been answered and the loss reported on 2026-05-06 was not; the inspection of 2026-06-08 fell inside the coverage's 90-day restoration window and put the lapse right from that day forward, never retrospectively.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Write 1's object is the claim reference CL-321884, entered on 2026-05-06 for a parted chain on NECK-32860 and sent to the bench on WO-321770; the correlation key is that claim reference, which ties the filing entry, the refusal that answers it through source_entry_id = 407b367f-b61b-4693-b2b5-2ebfe01d5f1a, and the workshop's order whose protection_claim_reference is CL-321884. Excluded by the same key: CL-321102 (a parted chain answered in November 2024), CL-321503 (a stone loss answered in August 2025, on WO-321188) and CL-321640 (a clasp answered in January 2026), all of which carry outcomes already. Writes 2 and 3 act on the plan record itself; the allowance entries that compose the benefit standing are the four already booked and the one this task adds, and no other plan or piece of this customer is in play.

FACTOR CARD, protection_ext_claim_refusal (five declared factors, exactly the count drawn). recorded_figure_basis (method): the claim stands entered for 12900.00, above the 10680.00 the piece is taken at, and no settlement entry falls inside the coverage year in progress, so the figure the refusal is recorded at is the value the piece is taken at; the computation document records the amount claimed, and would have given 12170.00. piece_value_taken (method, cross-difficulty on appraisal): the report AP-320655 on initial_state.appraisal_orders.3820ac03-eb6b-4a20-a8bd-864a1e07c768 is still current (valid to 2027-04-21) and was prepared for an insurance replacement, so the value taken is the 10680.00 it states; the baseline takes the 8900.00 the piece was sold at and would have given 8370.00. drawn_services_window (method): the coverage grants afresh each year and no allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress, so the routine work and goodwill drawn are counted over the twelve months to the handling date; the baseline counts them over the whole time the plan has been in force, the entry booked on the day coverage began included, which pulls in the chain repair settled on 2024-11-19 and would have given 10103.50. included_work_credit (parameter, cross-difficulty on service): the coverage includes chain and solder work and no chain repair has been drawn inside the window, so the Heritage Restoration Service charge of 85.00 for a chain solder comes off; the baseline takes nothing off and would have given 10146.00. goodwill_met (parameter): no refusal stands inside the window and the coverage allows two goodwill visits, so the goodwill share of 5 per cent, 534.00, comes off; the baseline meets nothing as goodwill and would have given 10595.00. Whole-baseline fall-back: 12900.00, which differs from the gold 10061.00.

FACTOR CARD, protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement (six declared factors, exactly the count drawn). yearly_allowance_basis (method, cross-difficulty on appraisal): the current report states 10680.00 against a value at purchase of 8900.00, so the yearly benefit allowance of 5000.00 is taken in that proportion, 6000.00; the baseline takes 5000.00 and would have given 2598.75. drawn_benefit_window (method): allowance entries stand and the coverage grants afresh each year, so what the plan drew is the benefit consumed by the settlements booked in the twelve months following the entry of 2025-03-14, that is 3150.00 on 2025-08-10 plus 900.00 on 2026-01-20, 4050.00; the baseline counts the twelve months to the handling date, where only the 900.00 falls, which drops the draw below the heavy-draw share and would have given 4158.00. after_draw_share (parameter): 4050.00 stands at or above half of 5000.00 and three settlement entries stand on the plan over its life, so the after-heavy-draw share of 0.75 applies; the baseline grants the whole and would have given 4158.00. late_grant_share (parameter): six whole months have passed since the anniversary of 2022-03-14, above the very-late threshold of five, so the very-late share of 0.7 applies; the baseline would have given 4455.00. inspection_year_share (parameter): one inspection entry stands in the twelve months to the handling date where the six-month interval calls for two, and the most recent, 2026-06-08, falls within that interval, so the lapsed-year share of 0.9 applies; the baseline would have given 3465.00. membership_uplift (parameter, cross-difficulty on circle): the Platinum membership d6cd9fa1-2a37-4d83-98fd-d667a2378db2 stands active with 21400.00 of qualifying spend since the tier took effect against a maintenance figure of 15000.00, so the maintained-member uplift of 1.1 applies; the baseline would have given 2835.00. The lifetime ceiling of 25000.00 less the 20000.00 already booked leaves 5000.00 of headroom, which does not bind on 3118.50. Whole-baseline fall-back: 5000.00, which differs from the gold 3118.50.

FACTOR CARD, protection_ext_transfer_carryover (four declared factors, exactly the count drawn). allowance_entries_window (method): an allowance entry now stands inside the coverage year in progress, the one written at step 11, so the entries counted are those booked inside that coverage year, 3118.50; the baseline counts every entry since the plan came into force, the grant booked on the day coverage began included, and would have given 16645.32. consumed_benefit_basis (method): a settlement stands in the twelve months to the handling date and an allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress, so the benefit consumed is what the settlements booked since that entry took, which is nothing; the baseline takes every settlement ever booked, 4690.00, which exceeds the benefit standing and would have given 0.00. tenure_carry_share (parameter): the plan has been in force four whole years, above the mid-tenure threshold of two and not above the long-tenure threshold of five, so the mid-tenure share of 0.9 carries; the baseline carries the new-plan share of 0.7 and would have given 1746.36. claims_carry_share (parameter): a refusal now stands in the twelve months to the handling date, the one written at step 9, and three settlement entries stand over the plan's life, so the refused-claim share of 0.8 carries; the baseline carries the whole and would have given 2806.65. Whole-baseline fall-back: 12899.95, which differs from the gold 2245.32.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS. The customer profile carries the three details the identity check uses. The plan row fixes the coverage, the piece, the value at purchase, the effective date every clock runs from, the term, the inspection dates and the displayed benefit figure. The sixteen ledger rows are the reconciliation: the premium receipt; the four allowance entries, whose latest is the eighteen-month anchor of the drawn-benefit window and whose absence inside the coverage year in progress is the first prerequisite; the four inspection entries, whose count in the last twelve months (one against the two the six-month interval calls for) drives the lapsed-year share and whose 2025-09-12 entry sets the due date the refusal ground rests on; the three answered claims, which supply the settlements-over-life count, the benefit drawn in the coverage year just ended and the chain repair that the twelve-month window excludes but the whole-life window would pull in; and the claim entered on 2026-05-06 without an outcome, which is the second prerequisite. The 2025-09-12 inspection is the near-miss of this task: it falls exactly twelve whole months before the handling date and therefore outside the twelve-month count, and a reader who counts it makes the inspection share 1.0. Remove the 2026-01-20 settlement and the drawn-benefit window factor stops biting; remove the appraisal row and both the refusal figure and the yearly allowance fall back; remove the Heritage work order and the included chain credit has no published charge to rest on. The workshop rows carry the level the chain work ran at and the stone work that the earlier claim answered; the membership row carries the tier and the spend the uplift rests on. Automatic clauses checked: no premium is owed (single payment, received in full), the next inspection is not due until 2026-12-08, the term runs to 2027-03-13, the allowance is not consumed, and the coverage's cap of four settlements in a rolling twelve months and its minimum of 30 days between settlements are both satisfied, so nothing is lit that this task does not discharge. The one stamp-like field, protection_plans.remaining_benefit_allowance = 1850.00, is stale by design: it still shows what was left in the coverage year just ended after the January settlement and was never refreshed, because the anniversary grant was never booked. No rule reads it.

PERSONA DESIGN. Anselm is written as an unhurried, sentimental man with a firm deadline and a slight pride in his own memory; the voice is longer sentences, a little circling, and a gift at the centre of it. He volunteers only the surface request and the wedding; his identity details, the daughter's name, the necklace's time at the workshop and the missed winter check-up all come only when asked. The only customer-stated value any gold argument takes is the daughter's name, which he asks to be written exactly as he gives it. His passive reactions are tied to what the agent says, being told the spring claim is refused, being told the year's benefit has been put back, being told what goes across, never to the state of the database, and his guess that there would be five thousand on it is wrong and is used by nothing.

THE DEPENDENCY, LONG AND BROAD. Long: the surface goal (pass the cover to the daughter) leads to the root policy's own rule, which says what carries across is fixed only after the allowance entries carry a grant for the coverage year in progress and that coverage passes only once every claim the coverage does not answer for carries its ground of refusal; the ledger shows no grant since 2025-03-14 and a claim from 2026-05-06 with no outcome; the grant policy and the refusal policy each give a single figure; and only on the world both leave is the transfer figure the right one. Broad: the refusal reads the appraisal register, the workshop's service level, the claim ledger, the allowance ledger and the coverage's included services and goodwill allowance; the grant reads the appraisal register, the membership, the settlement history in two different windows, the inspection count and the lifetime ceiling; the transfer reads the allowance entries, the settlements, the refusals and the plan's tenure.

EASY MISTAKES AND HOW THE POLICY EXCLUDES THEM. Settling the spring claim instead of refusing it: the inspection policy says coverage resumes from the day the inspection was logged, never retrospectively, so a loss that happened while the coverage was out of good standing stays refused. Refusing it on the excluded-peril ground: a parted chain is among the perils this coverage answers for. Counting the 2025-09-12 inspection as inside the last twelve months, when it falls exactly twelve whole months back. Recording the refusal at the 12900.00 claimed rather than at the 10680.00 the current report states. Granting the plain 5000.00 yearly allowance and ignoring the report, the draw, the lateness, the inspections and the membership. Reading the displayed 1850.00 as the benefit standing. Transferring first and granting afterwards, which would carry 0.00 across.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Find the customer and verify him; read the coverage, its whole ledger, the appraisal register, the workshop's orders and lines and the membership; see the claim of 2026-05-06 without an outcome and work out from the inspection of 2025-09-12, the six-month interval and the 45-day grace that the loss fell while the coverage was out of good standing; refuse it at 10061.00 on the inspection-lapse ground; see that no allowance entry stands since 2025-03-14 and grant 3118.50 for the coverage year in progress; then hand the transfer to the customer to confirm, with 2245.32 going across to Delphine Thibodeaux-Moreau.

VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RUN. The three computations were evaluated with the gate's own evaluator (skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py, build_env and eval_compute) on their handling-time worlds. Output: protection_ext_claim_refusal result=10061.0 (22 bindings, 15 branches), per-factor baselines 12170.0, 8370.0, 10103.5, 10146.0, 10595.0, whole baseline 12900.0; protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement result=3118.5 (24 bindings, 22 branches), per-factor baselines 2598.75, 4158.0, 4158.0, 4455.0, 3465.0, 2835.0, whole baseline 5000.0; protection_ext_transfer_carryover result=2245.32 (15 bindings, 11 branches), per-factor baselines 16645.32, 0.0, 1746.36, 2806.65, whole baseline 12899.95. Prerequisite sensitivity with the same evaluator: transfer without the grant 0.0, transfer without the refusal 2806.65, against gold 2245.32. Order uniqueness: with the grant written first the refusal still computes 10061.0.

REWORK, ROUND 2 (audit revision_1; this task passed and its gold is unchanged). F-3: the two included-services sentences on the rolling twelve months and on the goodwill allowance are now named in protection_ext_claim_refusal's overwrite and replaced by the rule's own window and goodwill ladders. F-4: the base transfer-fee sentence is now named in protection_ext_transfer_carryover's overwrite and replaced by the rule's own sentence that the fee is taken at the counter and not booked against the coverage being passed on. F-5: piece_value_taken is relabelled a method, the same shape as repair_figure_basis. F-6: baseline.params on the refusal and on the transfer now list only the keys their baselines read. O-2: the whole-life windows now count one month more than the whole months since coverage began, so the entry booked on the effective date itself is included and the literal and the encoded baseline agree; the transfer's whole baseline moved from 9399.95 to 12899.95 and its allowance_entries_window baseline from 13045.32 to 16645.32, gold unmoved. W-1: the persona line after the agent announces the refusal no longer names the missed check-up as the ground.

CLOSURE. protection_ext_claim_refusal, record_claim_refusal_9dff8781, computations[0] (arg refused_amount, step 9), a protection_claim_denied entry of 10061.00 under CL-321884 on the inspection-lapse ground; protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement, reinstate_benefit_allowance_e0b143ff, computations[1] (arg allowance_amount, step 11), a protection_allowance_reinstated entry of 3118.50; protection_ext_transfer_carryover, confirm_coverage_transfer_42b50f64, computations[2] (arg allowance_carried_across, step 13), the plan closed as transferred to Delphine Thibodeaux-Moreau with 2245.32 standing on it and a confirmed transfer on the desk's request record. charter_scope, required_documents and the computations name the same three policies in the same order, and the task tools are exactly the three the gold calls, in first-use order.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published rules, the tool schemas, what the share tools return and what Anselm actually says: he asks for the cover to pass with the piece; the transfer rule itself says the figure waits on a grant for the coverage year in progress and on every claim the coverage does not answer for carrying its ground of refusal; the ledger shows exactly one claim without an outcome and no allowance entry since March 2025; the refusal rule gives one figure from the report, the claim and the included chain work; the grant rule gives one figure from the report, the draw, the lateness, the inspections and the membership; and the transfer rule then gives one figure from the entries, the settlements, the tenure and the refusals. Each ladder's tiers are disjoint as stated and every quantity they read is a record the share tools return, so no second reading produces another number.
user_scenario:
Anselm Thibodeaux is seventy-one, a retired high-school band director in Oak Park who still keeps every receipt in a shoebox and will tell you so. He speaks slowly and tells a little of the story before he gets to the point. He is fond of the piece he is ringing about, a platinum riviere necklace he bought his late wife in 2022 and has looked after ever since. His daughter marries in November, he has decided the necklace should be hers now, and what he wants from the protection desk is that the cover on it should go with the piece instead of stopping when he hands it over. He says that plainly, and he wants it arranged today, because she collects it at the weekend.

He offers his name at once and, when the desk needs something to find him by, reads out the number he has had for thirty years, 3125553268. If more is wanted he gives his date of birth, 1955-02-23, and the last four digits of his driving licence, 3274, proud that he still knows them by heart. He does not know his plan number and says he would have to dig the folder out of the hall cupboard; he would rather the desk found it from his name.

The daughter's name, when he is asked who the cover should pass to, is Delphine Thibodeaux-Moreau, and he is particular that it be written exactly that way, hyphen and all, because she took both names when she married. He is content for the desk to do whatever the record needs on his side, but says he understands he has to be the one to sign the piece over himself, and he will do that while he is on the line.

Only when he is asked does he say that the necklace went in to the Oak Park shop in May, when the chain parted, that he paid for that repair at the counter himself, and that he had it back in June. Only when he is asked does he say that he had it looked over when he collected it, and that before that he had let a check-up slide over the winter because of a hip operation. He raises nothing else about the plan; as far as he is concerned it has been quiet.

If the agent tells him the claim from the spring is being refused, he takes it in good part: the man at the counter had warned him at the time that it might well not be covered, so it is no surprise to him, and he asks the agent to carry on. If the agent tells him the benefit for this year has been put back on the plan, he says that is good news for his daughter and that she may as well start with it.

When he is told what benefit goes across with the necklace he is quiet for a moment and says he had thought there would be five thousand on it, the way there always used to be, but he does not press the point and does not argue when it is explained. He signs the transfer over himself when it is handed to him, reads the confirmation back, and once he hears that the cover stands in his daughter's name he thanks the agent, says something about the wedding, and rings off with nothing further to ask.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Select the caller's customer profile from the mobile number he reads out and read back the details the identity check is measured against.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing on the account is reachable without the customer reference this returns, and the date of birth and identification digits he states are checked against this profile.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Measure the two details he states against the profile on file and record that he cleared the check.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must stand before any record of his is read or written, and two agreeing details are what the desk's check requires.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the coverage he holds: the plan variant, its status, the covered piece, the value it was sold at, the effective date, the term and the inspection dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Fixes the coverage every figure rests on, the effective date every clock runs from, the piece the appraisal and the work orders are matched on, and the plan reference all three writes are booked against.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole coverage history: the premium, the allowance entries, the inspections with their findings and dates, and every claim filed, settled or refused.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the reconciliation itself: the claim standing without an outcome, the absence of an allowance entry for the coverage year in progress, the settlements in two different windows, the inspection count and the inspection that set the due date the refusal ground rests on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the appraisal engagements for this customer, including the report standing on the covered piece with the value it states, the purpose it was prepared for and the date it stops being current.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The value the piece is taken at for the refusal and the yearly benefit allowance the grant rests on are both worked out from that report.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the workshop's work orders for this customer, including the one carrying the refused claim's reference and the service level it ran at.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The published charge for the chain work the coverage includes without a claim is the charge at the level that work order runs at.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the priced lines booked to those work orders, with the protection claim reference each was raised under and what the customer paid.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that the chain work of May was priced and paid by the customer at the counter, which is the work the coverage's included chain and solder cover answers for.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's loyalty membership: its tier, whether it stands in force and the qualifying spend recorded since the tier took effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's own tool for refusing a claim that stands open on a piece of coverage.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Answer the claim standing open on the necklace by refusing it: record the amount refused against the claim's own reference, with the single ground the refusal rests on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.protection_plan_id: The coverage record 7788a58b-b8bb-4622-abd6-6a64eb8299ba. Basis: the protection coverage lookup returns exactly one coverage record for this customer, on NECK-32860, the piece the claim names; the tool schema says this argument is 'the reference number of the coverage record the claim stands against, as returned by the protection coverage lookup'. Uniqueness: he holds one coverage record.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.claim_reference: CL-321884. Basis: the coverage history carries it on the filing entry of 2026-05-06, and the refusal rule says 'The claim being answered is the one last entered against the plan, and the work order it was sent in on is the one carrying that claim's reference.' Uniqueness: four claim references stand in the ledger; CL-321102, CL-321503 and CL-321640 all carry settlements, so only CL-321884 is still unanswered.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_entry_id: The coverage entry 407b367f-b61b-4693-b2b5-2ebfe01d5f1a. Basis: the tool schema says this is 'the reference number of the coverage entry on which the loss was first entered, as returned by the coverage history lookup; the refusal is recorded as the answer to that entry'. Uniqueness: exactly one entry carries claim_reference CL-321884 with event_type protection_claim_filed.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refused_amount: 10061.00, the value protection_ext_claim_refusal computes on the world at this step. The claim stands entered for 12900.00. A report stands on file for NECK-32860 that is still current (valid to 2027-04-21) and was prepared to state a replacement value for insurance, so the value the piece is taken at is the 10680.00 that report states rather than the 8900.00 it was sold at. The claim stands above that value and no settlement entry falls inside the coverage year in progress, which began on the anniversary six whole months ago, so the figure the refusal is recorded at is 10680.00. The coverage grants its allowance afresh each year and no allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress, so the routine work and goodwill drawn are counted over the twelve months to the handling date: in that window no chain repair has been drawn (the earlier one was settled on 2024-11-19, twenty-one whole months back) and no refusal stands. The coverage includes chain and solder work, so the workshop's published charge for a chain solder at the Heritage Restoration Service level the work order ran at, 85.00, comes off; and with the coverage allowing two goodwill visits, the goodwill share of 5 per cent of 10680.00, that is 534.00, comes off as well. 10680.00 less 85.00 less 534.00 rounds once at the end to 10061.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.claim_outcome: denied_inspection_lapse. Basis: the base claim-intake rule says 'where the coverage had lapsed for want of inspection it is refused under the inspection lapse ground', and the inspection rule says 'An inspection logged inside the restoration window puts the lapse right and coverage resumes from the day the inspection was logged, never retrospectively, so a loss that happened while the coverage was out of good standing stays refused.' Uniqueness: the inspection of 2025-09-12 set the next one due on 2026-03-12 under a six-month interval, and the coverage's 45-day inspection grace ran to 2026-04-26, so the loss entered on 2026-05-06 fell while the coverage stood out of good standing. settled_full and settled_partial are excluded because nothing is being paid; denied_exclusion is excluded because a parted chain is among the perils this coverage answers for; denied_outside_term is excluded because the term runs to 2027-03-13; denied_allowance_exhausted is excluded because allowance stood on the plan at the time; and not_applicable is excluded because the claim is being answered now.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.denial_reason_code: inspection_lapse. Basis: the base claim-intake rule says 'Where the peril is not covered the claim is refused under the excluded peril ground; where the coverage had lapsed for want of inspection it is refused under the inspection lapse ground; where the term had run out it is refused under the outside term ground; and exactly one ground is recorded.' Uniqueness: the peril is covered, so excluded_peril does not hold; the term had not run out, so outside_term does not hold; the allowance was not consumed, so allowance_exhausted does not hold; the customer's account of the loss reached the desk on the day the claim was entered, inside the coverage's 45-day proof-of-loss window, so no_proof_of_loss does not hold; and not_applicable is for entries that refuse nothing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's own tool for granting a coverage year's benefit allowance afresh.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock and call pair for the second write; it changes nothing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the benefit allowance for the coverage year now running, which the anniversary in March owed and which nothing has yet granted.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement is the only rule producing allowance_amount; until it lands no allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.protection_plan_id: The coverage record 7788a58b-b8bb-4622-abd6-6a64eb8299ba. Basis: the tool schema says this is 'the reference number of the coverage record the allowance is granted on, as returned by the protection coverage lookup'. Uniqueness: the customer holds one coverage record, and it is the one whose anniversary passed unbooked.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.allowance_amount: 3118.50, the value protection_ext_allowance_reinstatement computes on the world at this step. The coverage's yearly benefit allowance is 5000.00, and because a report that is still current states 10680.00 against a value at purchase of 8900.00, it is taken in that proportion: 6000.00. Allowance entries already stand and the coverage grants afresh each year, so what the plan drew in the coverage year just ended is the benefit consumed by the settlements booked in the twelve months following the entry of 2025-03-14, that is 3150.00 on 2025-08-10 and 900.00 on 2026-01-20, 4050.00 in all; that stands at or above half the yearly allowance and three settlement entries stand on the plan over its life, so the after-heavy-draw share of 0.75 applies. Six whole months have passed since the anniversary of 2022-03-14, above the very-late threshold of five, so the very-late share of 0.7 applies. One inspection entry stands in the twelve months to the handling date where the six-month interval calls for two, and the most recent of them, 2026-06-08, falls within that interval, so the lapsed-year share of 0.9 applies. The membership stands active with 21400.00 of qualifying spend since the tier took effect against a maintenance figure of 15000.00, so the maintained-member uplift of 1.1 applies. 6000.00 times 0.75 times 0.7 times 0.9 times 1.1 is 3118.50, below the 5000.00 of lifetime ceiling still unbooked, and rounds once at the end to 3118.50.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's own transfer confirmation and hand it over to him.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Giving away cover he paid for is his alone to do, so the desk unlocks the confirmation rather than performing it; the unlock changes nothing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer signs the coverage over himself: the plan closes as transferred to his daughter today, the benefit that goes across with the necklace is recorded on it, and the transfer is confirmed on the desk's request record.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: protection_ext_transfer_carryover is the only rule producing allowance_carried_across, and it is evaluated on the world the refusal and the grant have already changed; the confirmation is the customer's own write.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.protection_plan_id: The coverage record 7788a58b-b8bb-4622-abd6-6a64eb8299ba, the same coverage the claim was refused on and the allowance granted on. Basis: the tool schema says this is 'the reference number of the coverage record being passed on, as returned by the protection coverage lookup'. Uniqueness: one coverage record stands for this customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_owner_name: Delphine Thibodeaux-Moreau. Basis: the customer says 'The daughter's name, when he is asked who the cover should pass to, is Delphine Thibodeaux-Moreau, and he is particular that it be written exactly that way, hyphen and all', and the tool schema requires this argument 'copied character for character, keeping their wording, spelling and punctuation exactly'. Uniqueness: it is the only name he gives, and the schema forbids shortening or tidying it.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.allowance_carried_across: 2245.32, the value protection_ext_transfer_carryover computes on the world at this step. An allowance entry now stands inside the coverage year in progress, the 3118.50 booked at the previous write, so the allowance entries counted are those booked inside that coverage year, 3118.50. A settlement stands in the twelve months to the handling date and an allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress, so the benefit consumed is what the settlements booked since that entry took, which is nothing, leaving 3118.50 standing. The plan has been in force four whole years since 2022-03-14, above the mid-tenure threshold of two and not above the long-tenure threshold of five, so the mid-tenure share of 0.9 carries. A refusal stands in the twelve months to the handling date, the one written at step 9, and three settlement entries stand over the plan's life, so the refused-claim share of 0.8 carries. 3118.50 times 0.9 times 0.8 rounds once at the end to 2245.32.

edges.policy_source: What carries across to the new owner is fixed only after the allowance entries booked to the plan carry a grant for the coverage year in progress.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The coverage year in progress began on the anniversary of 2026-03-14, six whole months before the handling date, and the latest allowance entry on the plan is dated 2025-03-14, eighteen whole months back. No allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress, so the benefit standing on the plan is nothing at all.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The grant written at step 11 books a protection_allowance_reinstated entry of 3118.50 dated 2026-09-17, which falls inside the coverage year in progress, so granted_in_window moves from 0.00 to 3118.50 and the transfer figure from 0.00 to 2245.32.

edges.condition: every claim entered against the plan that the coverage does not answer for carries a recorded ground for refusing it
edges.policy_source: Coverage passes to a new owner only once every claim entered against the plan that the coverage does not answer for carries the ground on which it was refused.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The claim entered on 2026-05-06 under CL-321884 stands with no outcome and no ground: its claim_outcome and denial_reason_code are both not_applicable, and no refusal entry anywhere in the coverage's history carries that claim reference.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The refusal written at step 9 books a protection_claim_denied entry under CL-321884 with the ground inspection_lapse, so every claim the coverage does not answer for then carries its ground, and the transfer's claims_share binding moves from the whole of what would otherwise carry across, 1.0, to the refused-claim share, 0.8.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites hang in parallel off the root and may be taken in either order; both orders were run on this world and leave the same three writes with the same arguments and the same terminal state. With the refusal first, the grant computes 3118.50; with the grant first, the refusal still computes 10061.00, because the only binding of the refusal the grant could touch is the window the routine work and the goodwill drawn are counted over, and neither the chain repairs drawn nor the refusals standing differ between the six-month and the twelve-month window here. The refusal touches nothing the grant reads: the grant reads allowance entries, settlements, inspections, the report and the membership, and a refusal entry is none of those.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the grant and replaying everything else leaves no allowance entry inside the coverage year in progress, so the entries counted fall back to the twelve months to the handling date, where none stands: granted_in_window goes to 0.00, the benefit standing to 0.00, and allowance_carried_across from 2245.32 to 0.00; the terminal state also loses the protection_allowance_reinstated entry.

Skipping the refusal and replaying everything else leaves no refusal entry inside the twelve months to the handling date, so claims_share takes the fall-through tier of 1.0 and allowance_carried_across moves from 2245.32 to 2806.65; the terminal state also loses the protection_claim_denied entry, so the claim of 2026-05-06 stands unanswered.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names neither prerequisite problem nor what either resolves. Anselm asks only that the cover go with the necklace to his daughter; he never mentions a claim outstanding, an allowance, an anniversary or anything that must be settled first, and he asks no leading question. That the necklace was at the workshop in May and that he let a check-up slide over the winter are given only if the agent asks, and neither says that a claim stands unanswered or that a grant is missing. His contributions about both prerequisites are passive: after the agent tells him the spring claim is being refused he says the counter had told him as much and asks the agent to carry on, and after the agent tells him the year's benefit has been put back he is pleased for his daughter.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: confirm_coverage_transfer_42b50f64 reads the plan row, writes the request record and the plan's transferred status, new owner, closing date and benefit standing, and returns a confirmation line; it has no branch that inspects a claim outcome, a denial ground or an allowance entry, raises an error or refuses, so with either prerequisite unresolved it would still write the transfer with whatever figure it was given. reinstate_benefit_allowance_e0b143ff likewise books its entry without looking at any claim, and record_claim_refusal_9dff8781 without looking at any allowance entry.
